note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the North Dakota 2025-2026 Regular Session (LegiScan 2140). Seats are LegiScan's `district` field, which is correct for all 142 members here and is read in preference to `role`. The 23 committee sponsor pseudo-people in the people file (blank district, committee_id set) are excluded, the Maryland shape. 48 of 142 members map to a candidate: 47 proposed and accepted, 1 hand-added. The 94 nulls are dominated by North Dakota's four-year staggered terms: 62 of them sit in a district that is not on the November 2026 ballot at all, which is expected and is not a coverage gap. The other 32 hold a seat that is up but are not seeking it. Every unmatched member was checked by surname and by district against every unmatched candidate; only Mike Dwyer was a real miss.

Mike Dwyer, senate SD-047 in the 2025 session; hand-added. The candidate row's name is byte-identical to LegiScan's `name` field and the seat agrees, but LegiScan puts the legal first name `Michael` in `first_name` and the working name `Mike` in `nickname`, and the proposer reads neither `name` nor `nickname`. Neither `michael` nor `mike` is a prefix of the other, so the first-name prefix rule cannot reach it. Same class as the Pennsylvania, Connecticut, North Carolina, Indiana, Kentucky, Alabama, South Carolina and Oregon hand-adds.
